notes.title: [On Track Release]Monmusu Paradise ~Visitors~
notes.notes:
We are delighted to let you know,
that the release of our game Monmusu Paradise ~Visitors~ is on track to release at 20 June 2025.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3406800/Monmusu_Paradise_Visitors/

With it,
We also want to raise some awareness that in case of we have outstanding wishlists,
We will give you guys the player 3 additional heroines to fuck before the start of September!

The target is until the steam next fest end, so we hope you can help us to reach the target of 10k wishlist.
We're currently in around 500 so this might a bit steep but I will believe we can reach it.

Thank you for reading and happy fapping!

notes.title: Update and Patch! + Release of the Chinese Artbook and Novel Vol.01
notes.notes:
Thank you for people that give us inputs for making the game better and can be enjoyed more.
For answering your passion and love towards our game, the updates we have implemented will live soon next week after the final check. There is some update we cannot implement because of the engine limitation for now as for that we wish to give another alternative for it.
Updates: 
- Save Items in Cat Shop
- Tanuki Quest after the Chapel
- Now you can use multiple libido items.
- some minor item and skill fix.
- and a cheat sheet locked with the [spoiler]4242564[/spoiler]

For the F12 screenshots, we cannot do it for now.
But there is another solution, you can press ALT + "Print Screen" to capture your game window and upload it manually on steam. We are sorry as its conflict with the engine inner system that we cannot change or disable.
Though we will try to ask someone that know better if it can be done without breaching RPG Maker agreement.

PS: Together with it, we will release the Chinese new year artbooks, Codex Libido Oriens, and Siluman Fantasy The Novel Vol.01 by Heidi Fisk.
You can see his other monster girls works here.
https://www.amazon.com/Heidi-Fisk/e/B01I83DQ8I?ref=dbs_p_ebk_r00_abau_000000
Thank you for buying and loving our games.

Best Regards,


Siluman

notes.title: We have finished the official version and it will go on the store 19th April!
notes.notes:
Thank you for testers and fans that always helping us to fix and make our games better!
The release date for the game is decided on 19th of April!
Please try the game and give us your opinion to make it better.

After this, we start to finish the demo of the second half soon.
Support us by buying the game and artbooks for more bonus!

Thank you and see you soon!

notes.title: We are so sorry about the latest steam Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, and we hope this is a good day for you,

We want to apologize to you because of the latest steam updates,
Because the game content is too big Steam has requested us some save data to help them check the content. We are very sorry to have your save data rewritten and may force you to redo the game.

We are uploading the newest build with the save data folder in a different folder.
For people that haven't saved sync the update please back up your save data in a different folder first.
If there is anything we can do to for this apology please do tell.

Best Regards,


Siluman
